Padel score keeper and rules

Free padel scoreboard for casual games: tap to score, undo mistakes, share the result. No sign-up, works offline.

How to score

  • Scored like tennis: 15, 30, 40, game; deuce at 40–40 (many clubs play a single "golden point" instead).
  • Usually first to 6 games wins a set, by 2 (the app lets you pick 4 to 8); a tiebreak is played at 6–6.

Service

  • Serve underhand: let the ball bounce behind the service line and hit it below the waist.
  • Serve diagonally into the opposite service box. You get two attempts.

Walls & in/out

  • The ball must bounce once in court, then may hit the walls or glass.
  • After your side hits it, it may not touch your own walls/fence before the opponent's court bounce.

Winning

  • Usually best of 3 sets, played in doubles — use Tournament or Courts mode.

Scoring padel in DuelPoin

Tap the side that wins each POINT. At setup choose your house rules: games per set (4 to 8, usually 6) and Standard deuce or Golden point at deuce. The app tracks games and the tiebreak. Quick Match is one set; use Tournament and "Best of 3 Sets" for a full match. Optional: "Track who's serving" shows the server and side.
